toast.title: Package delivery
toast.body: Your parcel from Express Courier is out for delivery and scheduled to arrive between 14:30 and 16:00 today. The driver will ring the front intercom; if nobody answers, it will be left at the parcel locker around the corner on Main Street and a pickup code will be sent to your phone.
